description: This dataset contains observations of the flightless duck species *Tachyeres patachonicus*, also known as the Patagonian crested duck, collected from various locations in Argentina and Chile. The records include taxonomic classifications, geographic coordinates, observation dates, and metadata such as identifiers, licenses, and contributors. The semantic profile highlights biodiversity-focused attributes, including taxonomic hierarchies, spatial measurements (latitude, longitude, and coordinate uncertainty), temporal filters (day, month, year), and attribution details (identified by, recorded by). This dataset can be used for ecological studies, conservation efforts, and research on the distribution and behavior of flightless ducks in their natural habitats. It also supports analyses of species occurrence patterns and environmental interactions.
